title: Listening Drill — School concert access
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: School concert access
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the school concert. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns arrival time.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the west door. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the covered walk instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Ruth rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, put your phone on silent. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
